user_story: As a user, I want to ensure that the images on the 'Broken Images' page are accessible and their integrity is maintained, so that I can verify that broken images are displayed correctly. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I visit the page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/broken_images', I should see the heading 'Broken Images' (selector: 'Broken Images'). 2. I should see a footer with the text 'Powered by Elemental Selenium' (selector: 'Powered by Elemental Selenium').
